newsitem.title: USA: Major appliance shipments even, but exports strong.
newsitem.headline: Major appliance shipments even, but exports strong.

text.p: First-quarter major appliance shipments totaled 13,098,700 units, virtually even with the 1996 first quarter, reported the Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers.

However, first-quarter exports of 1,089,000 exceeded last year by 17.3 percent, with strong performance by cooking appliances which totaled 307,900 units, up 108.3 percent over last year, the trade group said.
March shipments of 5.3 million units were down 0.2 percent from the same month last year, it said.
